description.value: Copper Horse Lodge is a hotel in Golden, BC, positioned just steps from the base of Kicking Horse Mountain Resort and a short walk from the gondola. It serves as a base for mountain adventures at one of Canada's world-renowned ski and outdoor destinations. Downtown Golden, with its dining and shopping, is described as only minutes away.
